name: unipaper-bridge
description: Research papers autonomously, build evidence matrices, audit draft claims locally, use lawful institutional access only when needed, and preserve important sources in Zotero with user consent.

interface.shortDescription: Research, evidence, draft audits, and Zotero
interface.longDescription: Runs the normal scholarly research workflow, performs bounded one-hop expansion into earlier, later, and similar papers, verifies readable full text, builds source-anchored evidence matrices, audits unpublished draft claims through a local read-only MCP, opens the isolated local KHU browser only as a last-mile fallback, and saves material sources to local Zotero after opt-in. It never returns university credentials, cookies, sessions, or licensed full text through MCP.
defaultPrompt: Research this paper, build a source-anchored evidence matrix, audit any draft claims locally against exact DOI and source locations, use my configured university access only when needed, and save material sources to Zotero when authorised.
핵심 논문과 선행·후속 연구를 조사하고 근거표를 만든 뒤, 초안이 있으면 문장별 인용을 로컬에서 DOI·페이지까지 검증하며, 필요한 경우에만 경희대 접속을 쓰고 중요한 원문은 허용된 경우 Zotero에 저장해줘.
